set.body: After image core is narr-free, migrate remaining production and test uses in registration, motion, response, surface, dataset, atlas, spatial, latent, threshold, fit, workflow, and archived interop. Use Ravel rank-1/rank-2 data where values are arrays and retain semantic wrappers only for real invariants. Remove direct narr declarations from response, surface, and dataset. Acceptance: repository source scan and dependency graph contain no narr; compileAll and testAll pass on JVM and Scala.js; no public NArray signature remains.
set.title: Remove narr from remaining ScalaFIM modules
